title: More ways to see your charts
notes: Every dashboard chart has a More charts menu: heatmap of busy days, area, stacked area, smooth and step lines, 100% stacked, pie, rose, lollipop, funnel, radar and sunburst
Tick Show values on the chart, Average line (with highest and lowest marked) or Compare with last month (dotted line behind)
Pick a colour set for each chart; your choice is saved with the view
The lock screen now shows the RocketSales logo, the time, the quote of the day and moving waves in your theme colour
Freeze a column in any grid: hover a column title and click the small pin. It stays in view while you scroll sideways, and is remembered for next time

title: Faster lists: your computer keeps its own copy
notes: Customers, Doctors, Products and Prospects are copied to this computer once; afterwards only what changed is fetched, so searching and paging are instant and the lists keep working offline
After 12 hours working offline the app asks for your password again
Your provider can allow a remote support session for a few hours, so support can connect
The presentations list has a Present button on every row, to play a presentation without opening the editor

title: Stronger protection for your screen and data
notes: The app window is hidden from screenshots and screen recorders
If a screen-recording or remote-control program is running, the screen is covered, your administrator is told, and you are signed out if it is not closed within 30 seconds
The app locks after 10 minutes without use (5 minutes on a saved offline copy); enter your password to continue
Copied text is cleared from the clipboard after a minute; your administrator can stop some roles from copying or printing

title: Presentations: Latest or Static, folders, audiences and automatic backup
notes: Each presentation is Latest (live pictures) or Static (frozen); every picture and slide shows a badge, also in PDF and PowerPoint
Freeze a copy, automatic dated copies before numbers are refreshed, and a comparison slide against your last frozen copy
Audience, weekly or monthly period, folders, tags, search, Recent and pins; agenda, section and sign-off slides
New Presentations entry in the left menu; a warning names live pictures that cannot be refreshed
Automatic locked backup to Documents\RocketSales\Presentations (last 5 files, at most once a day) and Back up all

title: Presentations: live pictures, PowerPoint, notes, backup and sharing
notes: Pictures you add from a page are now live: when you present, the app retakes them from their page so the numbers are current (every 5 minutes while presenting, or press R). You can keep any picture as it is
Save a presentation as a PowerPoint file; titles, text and speaker notes stay editable
Speaker notes for each slide (press N while presenting), a logo and footer line for the whole presentation, and ready-made starter presentations
Back up all your presentations to one file, optionally locked with a password, and share a presentation with a colleague as a file; they open it with Open a file and get their own copy

title: Presentations, best-fit text and one computer per person
notes: My presentations: click Add to presentation in the top bar, pick any card, chart or table, and put it on a slide; add titles and text, change fonts, size, colour, alignment and layout, then play full screen or save as PDF or picture. Presentations are yours alone and stay on this computer
On first use on a new kind of screen the app suggests the text size that fits best; very large screens keep content to a readable width
Each computer now proves it is the one registered for your account; RocketSales sets how many computers a person may use (default one) and moves you to a new computer on request

title: Data window
notes: Slide panels (record details, orders, forms) now have a title bar in your theme colour
If your company is limited to recent data, reports and orders show only that period and say "Your company is allowed data from ..."

title: What is new, full screen
notes: What is new opens as a full-screen page instead of a small dialog; Back to the app or Esc returns you

title: A new quote at every sign-in
notes: The sign-in screen shows a different quote each time it opens; every quote is shown once before any repeats
App settings has a switch for one quote a day instead; the dashboard shows the same quote you saw at sign-in
A thought set by your company on the web still comes first

title: App users and roles
notes: App User list: Location and Transfer stock location columns removed; a reset-session icon (asks for Reset remarks) and then an edit icon sit at the end of each row
Add and the status switch are for the support account only; the new-user password is now required and its box is full width
Backoffice Roles: turning off the last page in a section also turns the section off

title: Battery tag and copyright line
notes: Attendance shows the phone battery as its own tag: green at 95% or more, amber 20 to 94%, red below 20%; a late start time still shows red by itself
Ask RocketPilot who started with low battery
The sign-in page shows the company copyright line and the app version
What is new has RocketPilot on the left and the text on the right

title: A livelier What is new
notes: What is new now follows your app theme and shows RocketPilot celebrating, with the newest release on top
Touch RocketPilot's picture to see his moods one by one, including a celebration

title: Meet RocketPilot
notes: RocketPilot now has a face: a friendly robot who greets you, thinks while he works, talks while he answers, and looks alert or pleased to match the answer
He also appears on the dashboard card; you can hide him with the Hide link in the panel
Fix: the Windows build error that stopped the What is new screen from reaching you

title: Forecasts and What is new
notes: RocketPilot AI forecasts: ask who will miss target this month, with the likely month-end sales and what is needed per day
RocketPilot AI: customers about to go cold, judged against how often each is usually visited
What is new: click the version number to read these notes any time, with a dot until read
Recent and Most asked keep only questions it understood, with a cross to remove one
A quote of the day from well-known sales coaches on the sign-in screen and dashboard (your company's own thought still comes first)

title: RocketPilot AI grows, and release notes
notes: RocketPilot AI: ask about a customer or a person and get their last visit, amount owed and stock expiring
RocketPilot AI: morning and end-of-day briefings, weekly and monthly review, visit plan
RocketPilot AI: reminders, most asked questions, print an answer, a count of what needs attention on the button
Update alerts: a sound and these notes whenever a new version is ready, checked every half hour
What is new: click the version number at the bottom of the menu to read these notes again

title: RocketPilot AI
notes: RocketPilot AI answers questions from the reports saved on this computer, with no server call
Side, Half and Full panel views; a list of questions it could not answer for the administrator
Company settings for the limits, pinned questions and who can use it

title: Row colours
notes: Attendance and other reports colour rows by performance (late starts, absences, targets, ageing, expiry)
Colours button: choose your own limits or return to the company's

title: Maps, SMS and look
notes: Map View: check a customer's tag against where visits happened
Promotional SMS screen; text size and clearer colours in every theme; new logo
